name: Interview
description: Signal from a candidate or user interview, kept separate from judgement.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.instruction: What was covered and the overall shape of the conversation. Do not offer a hiring or product recommendation here.

sections.heading: Topics Covered
sections.instruction: The questions asked and the areas explored.

sections.heading: Notable Responses
sections.instruction: Specific things the interviewee said that carry signal, quoted or closely paraphrased. Include the claim and its supporting detail together.

sections.heading: Questions They Asked
sections.instruction: What the interviewee wanted to know. Omit if they asked nothing.

sections.heading: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Anything either side committed to after the call.
